title: Propshaft Universal Joint Angularity & Driveline Torsional Vibration
description: Upper-intermediate engineering module investigating propshaft universal joint angularity & driveline torsional vibration.
learning_objectives: Master professional Gerund vs Infinitive Nuances in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in propshaft universal joint angularity & driveline torsional vibration
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: If the metallurgical heat treatment had been performed properly in Kopřivnice, the drive axle _____ under heavy mining loads today.

explanations.correct: Mixed conditional: past cause ('had been performed') with present result ('today') takes 'would not deform'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'would not have deformed' refers to past result, but the adverbial 'today' anchors the consequence to the present.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will not deform' is First Conditional, incompatible with past unreal condition.
explanations.wrong_D: Simple present indicative 'does not deform' cannot express hypothetical consequence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Mixed Conditionals connect a past action with a present state of affairs: 'If it had been treated [past], it would not deform [today]'.
